note: Item wording, block intro texts and response anchors transcribed from the study's own OSF codebook (osf.io/zevcs, 'Codebook Personality Change Intervention Study.pdf', osf.io/download/ypkfn, sha256 92b44918902860a60ec0dfed87315db8999ad75d6b04cfd78a962154bff74ce1, pp.16-22, 'Self-improvement: Pre' and 'Self-improvement: Post'), which prints each item against its SoSci variable (SB05, SB06_01, SB07_01..15, SB01_01/02, SB12_01..15, SB04_01..03, SB13_01/02, SB16_01). Code derivation: data/personalitychange_kramer.py (si_pre_cols/si_post_cols) uses the source column names as item codes (deposit .rda files in reproduce.zip, osf.io/download/6xv7f, sha256 e412511f24fcef642cd6f7c7410dfa6c9db8db3750a5cb8f148490d986be79fa, already lowercase) -- no positional step. The .rda columns carry no variable/value labels, so the tie is the codebook's explicit codes, hence paper_explicit. Live table reproduces the same-named .rda columns exactly: 40/40 items match per-item n, sum and sum of squares, each fingerprint unique among all numeric sb* columns (verify_personalitychange_kramer_2025_si.R). The authors' clean_data_st1.R/st2.R comments independently restate the wording for sb05 (with coding 1 = yes, 2 = no), sb06_01, sb01_01/02, sb13_01/02 and sb04_01..03, identical to the codebook. Deviations/literal choices: (1) anchors the codebook prints as a bare '2='/'4=' (sb06_01, sb07_*, sb12_*) or '2='..'6=' (sb16_01) are unlabelled and ship with blank option_text. (2) The SB12 intro says 'where 1 = I am completely the same and 5 = I have changed a lot' while the printed anchor for 1 is 'I have not changed' and for 3 'I have changed a little more'; both are shipped as printed, unreconciled. (3) Items with no intro text (sb05, sb06_01, sb01_*, sb13_*, sb16_01) share section _1 with a blank section_prompt; the three intro texts (SB07 pre facets, SB12 post facets, SB04 behaviour frequency) are section_prompts because they differ by block; instructions blank. Free-text SB08/SB09/SB14 are not in the table and were not transcribed. Anchor direction corroborated from the deposit: sb06_01 mean 3.50/3.48 when sb05=1 (yes) vs 2.15/2.10 when sb05=2 (no), Studies 1/2; sb04 frequency mean correlates +0.50/+0.50 with sb12 perceived-change mean. Scope caveats (table, not text): sb01_01/02 (n=356) and sb13_01/02 (n=338) are Study 1 only; sb16_01 (n=262) Study 2 T3 only (codebook note + script); the table mixes pre (sb05, sb06_01, sb07_*, sb01_*) and post (sb12_*, sb04_*, sb13_*, sb16_01) blocks. Rights: study-authored ad hoc measures. sb07_*/sb12_* are 15 single adjectives naming the BFI-2 facets (Sociable, Assertive, ... Creative); they are not BFI-2 items (the register's BFI-2 block covers the item sentences, e.g. 'Is outgoing, sociable'; none appears here), and the BFI-2's own facet names are nouns (Sociability, Assertiveness, ...).
